'''Maundadan Chetti''' ({{ipa|cty|mɐu̯ɳɖɐd̪ɐn t͡ʃeʈːi|ipa}}) or '''Chetti''' is a Kannadoid [[Southern Dravidian languages|Southern Dravidian language]] of [[India]] spoken by Maundadan Chetti community in the Nilgiri district of Tamil Nadu and in the Wayanad district of Kerala, India. Its highest lexical similarity is with [[Badaga language|Badaga]], which one calculation put at 57%, and it has somewhat lower similarities (47%–41%) with Kannada, Malayalam, Tamil and [[Wayanadan Chetti]].
